The described physical therapy techniques for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow) are effective and align with current clinical guidelines. Manual therapy can help reduce pain and improve tissue mobility, while eccentric strengthening exercises for the wrist extensors are considered the gold standard for rehabilitating this condition, as they promote tendon remodeling and load tolerance. Ice therapy is appropriately used post-exercise to manage acute inflammation and pain, supporting the athlete's ability to continue the rehabilitation program.
